title: Prepare the nodejs-cli-pattern skill app plumbing
objective: Create the initial TypeScript/ESM Node.js CLI application plumbing for the nodejs-cli-pattern skill, including stable help/version flags and a bounded release task.

branch.name: main
branch.rationale: The repository is already on the main branch and the user requested a reviewed commit on the current repository.

request.text: Prepare the plumbing of a ~/.cline/skills/nodejs-cli-pattern/SKILL.md app in this repository. Support -h|--help and -v|--version. Include a release task in a .docs/work-items/* directory. Review and commit changes after the work-item.json and associated task files are completed.

scope.name: cli-application-plumbing
scope.description: Add the package metadata, TypeScript build configuration, compiled launcher, CLI entrypoint, and focused tests for the nodejs-cli-pattern application.
scope.reason: The repository needs a buildable application boundary before future skill-specific commands can be added.

scope.name: work-item-release-record
scope.description: Record implementation, validation, review, and release task envelopes under the work-item steps directory.
scope.reason: The requested change must remain traceable and include an explicit release task without conflating local evidence with deployment approval.

nonGoals.name: domain-command-runtime
nonGoals.description: Do not implement domain-specific commands, provider integrations, HTTP services, or persistent application state.
nonGoals.reason: This request is limited to the initial CLI plumbing and stable terminal flags.

nonGoals.name: production-release
nonGoals.description: Do not deploy the application, publish a package, approve a release, or claim production readiness.
nonGoals.reason: The release task records a bounded local delivery procedure only.

items.name: stable-cli-help-version
items.description: The CLI must support -h|--help and -v|--version with deterministic output and successful exit codes.
items.reason: The initial application boundary must be discoverable and report its installed version consistently.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Both help spellings print usage information and both version spellings print 0.1.0 with exit code zero.

items.name: typed-esm-package-boundary
items.description: The application must use TypeScript, native ESM, Yarn metadata, and a compiled JavaScript launcher.
items.reason: The nodejs-cli-pattern skill requires one authoritative package/build convention that works for source and compiled execution.

acceptanceCriteria.description: yarn typecheck, yarn build, and yarn test complete successfully from the repository root.

items.name: bounded-release-task
items.description: The work item must include a delivery task that defines local release packaging and explicitly excludes deployment and approval.
items.reason: The requested release task must be traceable without overstating local validation as production release evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A task-envelope YAML file with taskType delivery and deliveryTypes including release exists below .docs/work-items/WI-0001/steps/.
